g: In accordance with / Following (method or rule)
Build Large Numbers by Place Value
Who Would Have Thought: 誰知道

s: 我和朋友到餐廳點了好多菜，最後沒吃完，只好打包回家。
Wǒ hé péngyou dào cāntīng diǎn le hǎo duō cài, zuìhòu méi chī wán, zhǐhǎo dǎbāo huí jiā.
My friend and I went to a restaurant and ordered a lot of dishes. In the end, we couldn't finish them, so we had to pack them to take home.
